name: macos-computer-use
description: Guarded local macOS desktop control for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and operate approved macOS apps from Codex
interface.longDescription: A local Codex plugin that adds screenshot-first, approval-aware macOS desktop control for app verification, QA, and local workflow automation.
defaultPrompt: Use macOS Computer Use to open an allowed app, inspect the UI, and verify my local build.
Use macOS Computer Use to take a screenshot, click through a low-risk flow, and tell me what changed.
Use macOS Computer Use to focus Xcode, inspect the simulator, and verify whether the latest build actually worked.
